text:
You find a large dagger with an
ornate hilt and elaborate etchings
on its blade. You may use it in
combat if you wish. Write down
”event #25 “ but do not read it
now. As soon as your blade hits in
combat, read #25.

zh-CN.title: 18 - 奇异刀刃
text: 你发现一把大匕首，刀柄装饰华丽，刀刃上刻着精致的纹样。你愿意的话，可以在战斗中使用它。记下“事件#25”，但现在不要阅读。刀刃在战斗中第一次命中时，再阅读#25。
